verificationSummary: Editor commit 3cc2cf9e008fa43bd0be491f4dc6ba83b041faf2 extends the bounded text-bearing node coverage lane. nodePresentationProjector now emits editable text-block descendants represented inside columns/table surfaces as depth 1 Outline items, while canvasSurfaceNodeIds and projectRenderNodes stay surface-based for the Core fixture. renderProjector attaches editableTextDescendants and representedNodeIds to composite render summaries so PaperBlock can open a selected nested text-block without rendering every internal node as a full paper block. editorView, editorState, and commandExecutor now make selection.selectNode source-aware: Outline can preserve exact editable text-block targets such as summary-left-text, while canvas hit-test and structural command paths continue to resolve internal nodes to their owning operation surface. runtimeBackendMutation preserves text-block.rich-inline.replace targets when the target remains an editable text selection target, fixing the live-smoke root cause where a nested text save applied successfully but selection snapped back to summary-columns. PaperBlock renders a non-button composite editing container with data-active-text-descendant-id and the shared PaperTextBlockEditorControls only for the active nested text descendant; inactive blocks remain keyboard-reorderable buttons, top-level text blocks keep the bounded textarea island, and no contenteditable runtime is introduced. RED evidence included npm run test -- --run src/tests/nodePresentation.test.ts src/tests/commands.test.ts src/tests/paperTextBlockEditor.test.ts failing for missing nested Outline rows, source-aware Outline selection, and embedded textarea rendering; npm run test -- --run src/tests/backendIntegration.test.ts then failed with summary-columns selected instead of summary-left-text for a nested text-block.rich-inline.replace apply. The first live Backend browser smoke after adding nested UI failed after save because the same runtime apply path selected summary-columns. GREEN evidence passed the focused 3-file/22-test gate, backendIntegration with 17 tests, editorBrowserLiveBackendSmokeEvidence with 1 test, and npm run check in the Editor worktree with 102 test files and 358 tests plus build. The live browser smoke starts real Editor and Backend loopback servers, selects summary-left-text from Outline, types Nested outline text editor, saves through text-block.rich-inline.replace mutation r8, reloads Backend api r8, reselects summary-left-text to verify textareaValueAfterReload and savedInlineText, confirms contentEditableCount 0, then reselects title and reorders afterward to mutation r9. Merged Editor main passed npm run check and FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0 npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke with the final Outline order editor-text-block-zone-cover-body-1 > title > editor-columns-zone-cover-body-2 > summary-columns > summary-left-text > summary-right-text > detail-table > detail-cell-a-text > detail-cell-b-text. This evidence does not enable WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, exact table cell editing UI, exact column layout editing UI, arbitrary rich-inline authoring beyond the existing first editable text/line-break range, field-ref chip editing, generic table/toc/page-break add paths, document v4 insert semantics, durable draft persistence, collaboration, large-document performance readiness, accessibility readiness, visual regression readiness, export parity, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, broad corpus coverage, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth.
